name: agentarmy-abstraction-mcp
description: Abstraction meta-service MCP server (ARC-ADR-036): a dedicated, single-purpose MCP exposing abstract_schemas + build_adapter that PROXIES backend-core's /abstract — the engine, embedder, and provider keys stay server-side, so an external AI coding agent never holds our secrets. Served streamable-http at /abstract so it sits under the existing mcp.untool.ai CF Access app (no new subdomain). The durable container home for what is otherwise a session-bound process.

env.ABSTRACTION_API_URL: backend-core base the proxy forwards to (default http://host.docker.internal:8000 for local docker; the in-cluster URL on ACA)
env.ABSTRACTION_TOKEN_FILE: (preferred) path to a mounted bearer for backend-core; re-read per call so rotation needs no restart
env.MCP_PUBLIC_HOST: host allowlisted for the MCP SDK DNS-rebinding protection (default mcp.untool.ai)

shims.note: Tiny by design — it only proxies backend-core/abstract, so no engine/embedder deps. Canonical server source is tools/mcp-abstraction/ (build context = repo root; no vendored copy, no drift).

baked.purpose: FastMCP server: abstract_schemas + build_adapter tools, served streamable-http at /abstract; DNS-rebinding protection on with MCP_PUBLIC_HOST allowlisted. Canonical source (build context = repo root).

Thin httpx proxy to backend-core POST /api/v1/ontology/abstract; reads the bearer per-call from ABSTRACTION_TOKEN_FILE (rotatable); rejects non-http backend URLs. Canonical source (build context = repo root).
Offline correctness gate: asserts both tools registered, the surface mounts at /abstract, and the proxy refuses a non-http backend — no backend/docker/keys needed.

doctor.description: Imports the server, lists its MCP tools (abstract_schemas + build_adapter), asserts the streamable-http surface mounts at /abstract, and asserts the proxy raises on a non-http backend URL. Live-verified separately: MCP initialize through CF Access at https://mcp.untool.ai/abstract returns 200.

deploy.notes: Build context = repo root: `docker build -f templates/abstraction-mcp-image/Dockerfile -t agentarmy-abstraction-mcp .`. Run 'serve' as an ACA app (internal ingress on 8181); front it via the existing mcp.untool.ai/abstract tunnel path or ACA ingress. Set ABSTRACTION_API_URL to the in-cluster backend-core and MCP_PUBLIC_HOST to the public host. Until then a logon Scheduled Task (AgentArmy-AbstractionMCP) runs server.py locally as the operator-box stopgap.

contract.note: Exposes the abstraction meta-service (abstract_schemas, build_adapter) as MCP tools; proxies backend-core /abstract. Keys stay server-side.
